item.title: Show CVBoosta:Resume Optimizer that tailors your resume to every job
item.summary: Show HN: CVBoosta – AI Resume Optimizer that tailors your resume to every job Hi HN, I’m an 18-year-old developer from Ukraine, and over the last few months I’ve been building CVBoosta. The idea came from seeing how frustrating modern job applications have become. Most companies use ATS systems, yet many applicants still send the same resume everywhere. I wanted to build a tool that helps people adapt an existing resume to a specific job description instead of rewriting everything from scratch. Current features include: * ATS compatibility analysis * Resume vs Job Description matching * AI-powered resume optimization * Keyword gap detection * Resume version history * Job application tracker * Native iOS app One thing that was important to me was keeping the user’s experience and achievements authentic. The goal isn’t to invent qualifications, but to present existing experience more clearly and in a way that matches each role. I’d really appreciate your feedback: * Is there anything missing that you’d expect from a tool like this? * What would stop you from using it? * How could it be more useful? Thanks for taking a look.
